card.name: The word infants in drug labels
card.fires_on: The word "infants" (usually with a leading space) in drug-label text about newborns, premature babies, and pediatric use. It is strongest after terms like "low birth weight", "newborn", or "neonates and".

modes.description: "infants" follows "in", "of", or a drug-exposed term in use or safety statements.
